user.title: Clima Smart
user.description: Pick the climate to drive and (optionally) the supporting sensors/switches. The controller does not create a new thermostat: it commands the existing one.

data.room_sensor: Bedroom thermometer, used as a lower limit (not as a target)

data_description.house_sensors: The rest of the house warms up before the bedroom: their average is the signal that allows starting before the peak.
data_description.presence_entity: If this entity says you are away, the deep night never starts on its own. Empty: it always does. A broken state counts as home.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Clima Smart
reconfigure.description: Update the linked entities (e.g. after the climate or a switch changed) without losing the tuned parameters.

init.title: Clima Smart parameters
init.description: Values used by the logic. The times delimit the phases: GAP (off) from the morning start to the day start; DAY until the night start; NIGHT the rest.

data.eco_band: Eco hysteresis (°C): eco OFF at target+band
data.auto_start_sleep: Start the unit when the deep-night window opens
data.auto_start_room: Start by itself when the room goes above (°C)
data.auto_start_house: ...or when the other rooms average goes above (°C)
data.auto_start_outdoor: Only if it is at least this warm outside (°C)
data.adaptive_outdoor_start: Adapt the target above this outdoor temperature (°C)
data.adaptive_slope: How much to raise it per outdoor degree
data.house_target: Comfort line for the other rooms (0 = disabled)
data.trim_min: Lowest target the controller may ask of the bedroom
data.trim_max: Highest target the controller may ask of the bedroom
data.room_floor: Temperature the bedroom must not go below (0 = no limit)
data.hot_outdoor: Outdoor temperature above which pushing further is pointless (0 = disabled)
data.trim_min_hot: Lowest bedroom target when it is scorching outside
data.night_start_outdoor: Outdoor below which deep night lets the unit rest (0 = disabled)
data.winter_room_start: Winter: bedroom temperature below which to help the radiators (0 = disabled)
data.winter_room_target: Winter: bedroom temperature to reach, then stop
data.winter_house_ceiling: Winter: do not heat if the other rooms are already this warm (0 = no limit)
data.start_approval: Ask for permission before starting (instead of starting by itself)
data.night_mild_outdoor: Mild night: outdoor below which deep night settles for less (0 = disabled)
data.target_sleep_mild: Mild night: room target when it is cool outside
data.efficiency_alert_minutes: Sustained poor efficiency: minutes above 45 measured Hz before flagging it (0 = disabled)
data.high_fan_guard_minutes: High-fan guard: minutes without gain before dropping to medium (0 = disabled)

data_description.auto_start_sleep: If the unit is off at that time, it is switched on once. Outside that moment the controller never starts it by itself.
data_description.auto_start_room: Daytime start: if the unit is off and the room goes above this, it is switched on once a day. 0 disables it.
data_description.auto_start_house: Second condition for the daytime start, independent of the room threshold. 0 disables it.
data_description.auto_start_outdoor: No daytime start below this outdoor temperature. 0 removes the guard.
data_description.vane_day_horizontal: Position restored when the deep night ends, once. Empty: the vanes are left where they are.
data_description.vane_day_vertical: Position restored when the deep night ends, once. Empty: the vanes are left where they are.
data_description.adaptive_outdoor_start: 0 disables it. Below this the target stays as configured.
data_description.adaptive_slope: For example 0.25 means half a degree of target every two outdoor degrees.
data_description.adaptive_max: Cap beyond which the target stops rising, however hot it gets.
data_description.house_target: Comfort line for the other rooms (0 = disabled)
data_description.trim_min: Lowest target the controller may ask of the bedroom
data_description.trim_max: Highest target the controller may ask of the bedroom
data_description.room_floor: Temperature the bedroom must not go below (0 = no limit)
data_description.hot_outdoor: Outdoor temperature above which pushing further is pointless (0 = disabled)
data_description.trim_min_hot: Lowest bedroom target when it is scorching outside

error.invalid_time_order: Times must be in order: morning off < day < night.
error.invalid_eco_range: "Eco ON when outdoor below" must be lower than "Eco OFF when outdoor above".
error.invalid_sleep_window: Deep night cannot start and end at the same time
error.invalid_wind_down: The deep-night window must end before the morning switch-off
error.invalid_trim_range: The bedroom's lowest target must be below the highest.

eco_on_not_below_off.message: The “eco outdoor ON below” threshold must be lower than “eco outdoor OFF above”.

eco_off_not_above_on.message: The “eco outdoor OFF above” threshold must be higher than “eco outdoor ON below”.

duplicate_aux_switch.message: Eco, mute and night mode must use distinct switches.

winter_start_not_below_target.message: The winter start threshold must sit below the bedroom target, otherwise the compressor short-cycles. Use 0 to disable winter assist.

winter_target_not_above_start.message: The winter bedroom target must sit above the start threshold, otherwise the compressor short-cycles. Use 0 to disable winter assist.

sleep_mild_not_above_sleep.message: The mild-night target must be above the deep-night one, otherwise a cool night would be cooled harder than a hot one.

sleep_not_below_sleep_mild.message: The deep-night target must be below the mild-night one, otherwise a cool night would be cooled harder than a hot one. Set the mild-night threshold to 0 to disable it.
